damageLaw: Her auto attack kills: a harp shot that lands fells any man on foot and takes half a heavy's bar (on MEGA all of it below level 70); Sarge and the heroes take her shot as bar hits (2, MEGA 3), as does every hit of her court, each landing at 50 % (the damper) × (90 % + 10 % × bar ÷ HP) of its weight on your men, and a level-70–90 man has 7 bar hits (6 the medic and spy, 8 the commando). No hit is an instant KO: the guard's ram and her face shot take 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) landing whole, and no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (he stands on 15 %); only her tongue's jump-back crit fells every man she licks, and her light arrows push (220 px) and kill nobody. Difficulty sets her bar by the designers' time-to-kill chart on EASY · MEDIUM · HARD and the player-damage-threshold pass on MEGA (2,706 · 3,608 · 1,804 · 7,560 with one commander), her lives (1 · 1 · 3 · 3: one full bar on EASY and MEDIUM, three full bars on HARD and MEGA, so 2,706 · 3,608 · 5,412 · 22,680 in all), her cadence and her tongue's, and the court's size (twice the sheet's old rows) and HP.
headlines: HER AUTO ATTACK KILLS (since v32.27): a harp shot that lands fells any man on foot, whatever his level, and takes half a heavy's bar (the bazooka, the flame and the commando, every machine: two shots; on MEGA one below level 70); Sarge and the heroes take her 2 (MEGA 3) bar hits as before, at the damper's 50 %.

THE JUMP-BACK CRIT: every 14 · 11 · 9 · 7 s her tongue reels the nearest man within 380 px to her feet; she hops back and one shot that always crits fells him (measured 0.31–0.32 s after the landing), a heavy too; never Sarge, a hero or a machine.
TWICE THE COURT: every body on her side comes twice: the lab's sheet 98 · 118 · 272 · 344 bodies in the waves (49 · 59 · 136 · 172 before); THE BUBBLE COURT HARD 6 + 6, MEGA 8 + 8.

NO INSTANT KO: the guard's ram and her face shot take 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) landing whole; a rifleman falls to one, every other man stands his first from a full bar on 15 % of it: a flame takes 3 rams, a Sarge 2 (the saber turns about half; THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block eat them first).

HER LIGHT ARROWS PUSH: with the wave her half bar releases (every tier now; MEGA again at a quarter) three bolts push every man they cross 220 px west (a machine 0.3 of it); the light kills nobody; a charged commando still catches one and throws it back for a quarter of her bar.

Her court comes on her bar (a wave holds while her court stands; the idle clock 56 · 48 · 42 · 42 s; 120 · 150 · 180 · 200 dog tags a wave cleared); HARD and MEGA give her three bars (1,804 / 7,560 each) with THE BUBBLE COURT at each retreat; the sage hurls a FIREBALL (2 bar hits within 60 px and a fire patch) beside his rings (a ring's 10 beats take 4.61 of a level-77 rifleman's 7 and he walks out; the 4 s mend gives 1 back before the next ring, 12 s on, which KOs him on its 8th beat) and his toad curse.

units.name: THE GNOME GUARD
units.note: walks 26 px/s · his ram costs HP now, no instant KO · his shield turns every 2nd round from the front, bullets do half and blasts double on his armour (measured) · a fairy's bubble makes him BIG: ×4 HP, ×1.5 size · Princess Croak's summoned guards charge the line at ×2.2 once big

attacks.name: RAM
attacks.cadence: braces 0.45 s then charges 380 px/s at a man ahead within 300 px, 100 px past him, rests 1.6 s
attacks.note: no instant KO (since v29.70): the ram takes 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) off the man's sheet, landing whole (the damper not taken; bar hits = that HP × bar ÷ HP), and no single hit fells a man other than a rifleman from a full bar (since v31.00: he stands on 15 % of it, the next fells him); measured on every tier: a level-70 rifleman KO'd at 0.92 s, a flame took 2.475 of his 7 bar hits and stood, a pistol Sarge stood on 1.65 of 11; the saber turns it about half the time (measured 14/15 · 12/12 · 11/15 · 12/11 of 16 fresh saber Sarges, E · M · H · G, Chrome/WebKit), THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block (1: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec) eat it whole (measured: the shotgun Sarge fell to ram 9 · 9 · 10 · 9, the Claymore to ram 3 · 3 · 3 · 3); the pet shield, the blue wall and the teal turn it; a jeep or the tank on the spear is destroyed (the V2 jeep and the tank measured); the scout jeep's own clip runs a mortal guard down first. The number in the table lands whole (the damper is not taken).

attacks.name: JAB
attacks.cadence: a man within 28 px, every 1.4 s (0.35 s wind-up); no ram
attacks.note: MEDIUM up; measured on a flame beside him. The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped — · 2 · 2 · 2 by tier).

units.name: THE GNOME SAGE
units.note: MEDIUM up (one at the pond; HARD three at the pond; MEGA three at the open and two at the pond) · walks 22 px/s

attacks.name: FIRE RINGS
attacks.cadence: the first at 6 s then every 12 s: the staff up 0.6 s, the rings 1.0 s, then 3 patches 56 px around their centres (112 px across) under your three rearmost men; a beat every 0.5 s for 5 s
attacks.note: 1 bar hit a beat, landing at the damper's 50 % (measured on a rifleman, a flame and a grenadier: a ring's 10 beats take 4.61 of a level-77 rifleman's 7 and he walks out; the 4 s mend gives 1 back before the next ring, 12 s on, which KOs him on its 8th beat); a medic beside a burning man mends him between beats (measured once). The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped — · 1 · 1 · 1 by tier).
attacks.code: gnCasterTick → fsIgnite → fsTick → tanHit (a fire beat)

attacks.name: FIREBALL
attacks.cadence: the first after 4 s, then every 9 s, never mid-spell: at the densest clump of your men within 420 px; it flies 260 px/s on an arc, a ring closing on the floor under it
attacks.note: since v31.40: 2 bar hits on every man within 60 px of where it lands, landing at the damper's 50 % (measured on a clump of three on MEDIUM up: thrown at 4 s, landed at 4.9 s, a rifleman took 0.921; a fourth man 130 px from their middle untouched), and a fire patch there that burns like his rings; a man who moves is not there. The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped — · 2 · 2 · 2 by tier).
attacks.code: gnCasterTick → pkbFbTick → pkbFbLand → tanHit (2 a man), fsIgnite

attacks.name: TOAD CURSE
attacks.cadence: a Sarge within 200 px, a 0.6 s cast, every 15 s
attacks.note: Sarge is a toad for 5 s: he hops at ×0.6 and cannot fire or swing (measured: 5 s); only a Sarge

units.name: THE FAIRY
units.note: hovers 80 px behind the front man · no hit on your men

attacks.name: MEND
attacks.cadence: 1 HP a second to every court body within 120 px
attacks.note: measured: a hurt guard 5 → 7 in 2 s; Princess Croak's summoned fairies never mend

attacks.name: BUBBLE
attacks.cadence: the first at 4 s, then every 10 s: a 0.6 s blow, the bubble flies 120 px/s at the front guard
attacks.note: the guard goes BIG: ×4 HP, ×1.5 size, jabs ×1.5 as often (measured at 5 s); one big man a fairy at a time

attacks.name: A BUFF IN FLIGHT
attacks.cadence: flies 120 px/s at the front guard
attacks.note: pops on a green round (1 HP); a bubble gains on a marching guard and stalls 12 px short of one who stands still (measured)

attacks.name: STING
attacks.cadence: dives 520 px/s at a man within 260 px, stings every man his pass crosses, climbs 2.2 s between dives (half that while a hornet is on the floor)
attacks.note: the stung man is HELD 2 s: no march, no gun (measured 1.98 s). The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped 1 · 1 · 1 · 1 by tier).

attacks.name: HEAVY STING
attacks.cadence: hangs 0.4 s over his man (the tell) then dives 420 px/s at a man within 300 px, climbs 2.6 s
attacks.note: HARD and MEGA; the man is bowled over (measured on a flame); while he lives every wasp dives twice as often. The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped — · — · 3 · 3 by tier).

units.name: THE POND FROG
units.note: born from the pool's rim; never walks

attacks.name: SPLAT
attacks.cadence: hops 460 px/s at a man within 150 px, one man a hop, every 2 s
attacks.note: plus a shove (measured on a rifleman 100 px off). The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped 1 · 1 · 1 · 1 by tier).

attacks.name: TONGUE
attacks.cadence: a man within 56 px every 2 s
attacks.note: beside a man he alternates tongue and hop about every 3 s each (measured: 6 hits in 7 s, 2.76 bar hits landed). The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped 1 · 1 · 1 · 1 by tier).

units.name: PRINCESS CROAK
units.note: walks 24 px/s · lives 1 · 1 · 3 · 3 (E · M · H · G) · her court comes twice (since v32.27) and on her bar: a wave holds while her court stands, then comes at 75 %, 50 % and 30 % of her bar (MEGA 25 % too) or after the idle clock

attacks.name: HARP SHOT
attacks.cadence: the nearest man within 400 px, every 2.4 · 2 · 1.8 · 2 s (E · M · H · G); she keeps 240 px off your line and backs off inside 160 px
attacks.note: HER AUTO ATTACK KILLS (since v32.27): a shot that lands takes at least a man's whole bar on foot, so he falls to the first whatever his level, and half a heavy's (the bazooka, the flame and the commando, every machine), so he falls to the second; on MEGA a heavy below level 70 falls to the first (measured on all eleven men on every tier, both engines, and by level: a level-100 rifleman and a level-1 medic one; a level-0 flame and a level-100 commando two; on MEGA a level-69 bazooka one, a level-70 two). Sarge and the heroes take it as before, in bar hits: the shotgun's riot shield eats the first 5 whole and the Claymore's counted block 1 (measured); the saber turns about half (block 0.5) and the gaps let his bar mend 1 every 4 s, so his count is arithmetic: 13 · 13 · 13 · 9 landed shots KO him only inside the mend, and the machines measured 34/18 · 59/66 · 16/29 · 12/26 landed shots to his KO (E · M · H · G, Chrome/WebKit, after 147/67 · 252/274 · 47/136 · 40/141 s); a shot a save turns takes nothing, the law included. The number in the table is what lands at the damper's 50 % (shipped 2 · 2 · 2 · 3 by tier).
attacks.code: updateFoePrincess (PC_SHOT) → tanHit (pipN; dmpX, the damper) → phxFloor (PHX_AUTO, PHX_HEAVY, PHX_LV)

attacks.name: TONGUE YOINK · JUMP-BACK CRIT
attacks.cadence: every 14 · 11 · 9 · 7 s from tell to tell (E · M · H · G; the first after half; 5 s while she stands on her stage after a retreat): the nearest man within 380 px with a clear line, never within 70 px
attacks.note: a 0.6 s tell, the tongue out, the reel (0.8 s) to her feet and a 1 s daze; then her hop back (80 px, 0.3 s) and one shot that ALWAYS crits (×2 her auto attack, since v32.27): every man she can lick falls, a heavy too (measured on a rifleman, a bazooka and a commando on every tier, both engines: down 0.31–0.32 s after the landing); never Sarge, a hero, a machine, a rider or a gun (measured: a pistol Sarge in her reach was never licked); 5 % of her bar landed during the reel snaps the tongue; with no man in reach a Dogfighter is pulled down and shot down
attacks.code: pykTell → pykLand → phxJbStart (her hop) → pcFaceShot → phxJbShot → tanHit (CRIT_MULT, her auto attack's law)

attacks.name: FACE SHOT
attacks.cadence: a Sarge within 84 px: a 0.12 s tell, a 80 px hop back (0.3 s), then the shot
attacks.note: no instant KO (since v29.70): 49.5 HP (MEGA 58.5) off his sheet, landing whole, and his full bar's first bite leaves him on 15 % of it (since v31.00), so it takes two (measured: a pistol Sarge at 60 px stood on 1.65 of 11); the saber turns it about half the time (the bite runs the bar hits' door, where his block rolls), THE RIOT SHIELD's 5 and the Claymore's counted block eat it whole (measured: kept 60 px off her the shotgun Sarge fell to face shot 9 · 9 · 10 · 9, the Claymore to 3 · 3 · 3 · 3, E · M · H · G), the deflect dome turns it; never a man or a hero (measured). The number in the table lands whole (the damper is not taken).
attacks.code: pcFaceShot → knock → knockKill (the KO price) → tanHit

attacks.name: LIGHT ARROWS
attacks.cadence: with the wave her half bar releases (every tier; EASY's since v31.40) and MEGA's quarter, and at HARD's and MEGA's retreats: a 2 s charge, then three bolts 120 px apart fly west at 900 px/s
attacks.note: the light kills nobody (since v31.40): every man whose figure a bolt's line crosses is pushed 220 px west (measured 200–208 px on foot), a machine 0.3 of it and never into the water (measured: the jeep slid 13–51 px); a column or a fountain stops a pushed man with a bump (one bar hit), the pool or the water stairs off a plank are a fall; measured on every tier: the three men on her three lines pushed, a medic 120 px under the lowest line untouched; a charged commando, the blue wall, the teal or a swinging Claymore catches a bolt and throws it back: she takes 25 % of her bar and every gnome it crosses falls (measured); a commando catches one bolt a fight (measured on MEGA: the second volley pushed him)
attacks.code: pflRelease → pflArrowTry → pcFire → the lightarrow shot branch → pkbArrowHit → ggShove (PC_ARROW_PUSH, PKB_VEH)

A dot in a cell's corner marks a man whose count the proof confirmed on both engines (Chrome for Testing + WebKit); the other cells are the read's arithmetic. A + in a cell's corner = a save ate some hits first (the riot shield's 5, the Claymore's counted block, the saber's turn): the number is every hit that reaches him, the save's share included; the words sit in the cell's tooltip.

The hits and the saves: no hit is an instant KO since v29.70. Her face shot and the guard's ram are priced bites (49.5 HP, MEGA 58.5, landing whole) that run the bar hits' door, so every save answers them: the saber turns about half (measured 14/15 · 12/12 · 11/15 · 12/11 of 16 fresh Sarges per tier turned the ram, Chrome/WebKit; the rest stood on 15 %), THE RIOT SHIELD (5 a battle, the shotgun) and the Claymore's counted block (1 a battle: THE DUELIST, every Claymore's default spec; the table's 3 only with FEAR or WALL picked) eat them whole (measured: the shotgun Sarge fell to ram 9 · 9 · 10 · 9 and face shot 9 · 9 · 10 · 9, the Claymore to ram 3 · 3 · 3 · 3 and face shot 3 · 3 · 3 · 3, E · M · H · G), the pet shield, the blue wall and the teal turn the ram, the deflect dome her face shot. Her auto attack's law and the jump-back crit fell a man only when the shot lands: a save that turns it turns the law with it. Her light arrows push and kill nobody.
